Chapter 1700: People from the Boundless Sea!

Chapter 1700: People from the Boundless Sea!

"I didn't expect to actually find another weak Eternal Sea!"
Qin Yu was quite excited internally.
The Boundless Sea was an Eternal Sea, and the Source Sea was also an Eternal Sea.
He knew of more than one Eternal Sea, but each was extremely powerful. It was his first time seeing an Eternal Sea like the Source Sea, where the strongest were only a few Legendary Realm Lords.
Such an Eternal Sea was bound to be very young. Although the resources born within might not be many, once such an Eternal Sea was controlled and his own strength developed, any precious resources born in the future, such as Eternal Supreme Treasures, could fall into his hands.
This was a great opportunity!
Moreover, there was a possibility of obtaining two Eternal Supreme Treasures this time.
As a member of the powerful Qin family in the Boundless Sea, they didn't have many Eternal Supreme Treasures. As a direct descendant young master of the Qin family, he had only been bestowed one Eternal Supreme Treasure. If he could obtain a few more, his strength would increase significantly.
"Luck is on my side this time. Fortunately, I captured the Dark Mist Lord in time; otherwise, such an opportunity wouldn't have fallen into my hands. Those Perfected Realm or even Domain Realm Legendary Lords would probably all want to come here," Qin Yu thought to himself.
From the Dark Mist Lord's mouth, he learned that the few Legendary Realm Lords in the Source Sea's Space-Time Territory were relatively weak, almost all being Ordinary Legendary Lords, with at most one Initial Realm Legendary Lord.
This time, he had brought eighteen Ordinary Legendary Lords, three Initial Realm Lords, plus himself—a top-tier Initial Realm Legendary Lord comparable to a Perfected Realm Legendary Lord. This was enough to occupy the Source Sea and make the many Eternal Realm beings submit.
Once he completely occupied the Source Sea, he would establish a Space-Time Staircase to connect to the Boundless Sea. By then, traveling between the Source Sea and the Boundless Sea would be very easy, and he could even dispatch experts from the Qin family at any time to guard this place, ensuring it wouldn't be taken by other forces.
Another period of time passed.
On this day.
The Dark Mist Lord led Qin Yu and these Legendary Lords to an area outside the Space-Time Territory, where they could sense various Space-Time Territories.
"It really is another Eternal Sea, but its structure is somewhat different from the Boundless Sea. The resources of the Source Sea are mainly concentrated in the Space-Time Territories, nourished by the Source Sea's origin energy, whereas our Boundless Sea birthed countless Boundless Islands that float upon it."
Qin Yu murmured.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!!!!
These Legendary Realm Lords instantly crossed this void region and descended upon the Space-Time Territory.
At this moment, Qin Yu commanded, "Dark Mist Lord, take me to your Lord Alliance headquarters."
The Dark Mist Lord whispered, "Young Master Qin Yu, shouldn't we go kill Ye Tian? That man has five clones; if he escapes, it might be bad."
"Do you intend to disobey my command? Besides, a mere Immortal Realm Lord is not worth mentioning. Once I've handled my affairs, I'll kill him for you in passing. If you say one more word of nonsense, you know the consequences," Qin Yu said impatiently.
The Dark Mist Lord's expression changed drastically, and he immediately dared not speak further.
Although Qin Yu had broken his promise, his strength was too weak to resist Qin Yu. Even if Qin Yu really didn't help him, he was helpless.
In reality, Qin Yu didn't care about the so-called promise at all; after all, the Dark Mist Lord had little value to him now.
However, Ye Tian definitely had to be killed, as it was highly likely he possessed an Eternal Supreme Treasure capable of boosting strength; otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to defeat the Legendary Realm Dark Mist Lord while only at the Immortal Realm tier.
But first, he wanted to control the Lord Alliance before dealing with Ye Tian.
Additionally.
As for whose hands the Eternal Supreme Treasure born in the Source Sea had fallen into, once he controlled the Lord Alliance here, he could find out.
Right now, controlling the Lord Alliance was the most urgent matter.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!!!
Qin Yu led the many Legendary Realm Lords and traveled to the headquarters of the Lord Alliance.
Boom!!!!
The auras of the Legendary Realm Lords spread out, instantly causing the many Eternal Realm beings in the Lord Alliance to tremble in fear.
At this time, Shengfeng Lord, Binghan Lord, Taihuang Lord, Jiguang Lord, and Liuyang Lord appeared one after another.
"So many Legendary Lords!!!"
Shengfeng Lord's expression changed drastically, looking completely incredulous.
When had the Space-Time Territory ever had so many Legendary Lords? Moreover, they were all unfamiliar faces, definitely not from the Space-Time Territory.
Furthermore, Shengfeng Lord saw a familiar face among these Legendary Lords—the Dark Mist Lord.
It could almost be guessed that these Legendary Lords were brought by the Dark Mist Lord and likely came from a place similar to the Source Sea, such as the Boundless Sea.
After all, there were several ruins from the Boundless Sea in the Space-Time Territory, so these people were very likely from the Boundless Sea.
"You must be the five Legendary Lords of the Source Sea Space-Time Territory Lord Alliance. From today onwards, your Space-Time Territory Lord Alliance will serve me. I come from the Qin family of the Boundless Sea. My name is Qin Yu, also known as the True Yu Lord, but I prefer people to call me Young Master Qin Yu."
Qin Yu spoke.
"What? Serve you?"
The faces of the five Legendary Lords immediately showed signs of anger, but due to the strength of Qin Yu and his group, they did not act rashly.
At this moment, Binghan Lord secretly notified Ye Tian.
The Space-Time Territory side was not without the power to fight. After all, these Legendary Lords who had arrived from the Boundless Sea had not brought their main bodies and clones; they must have only brought one body.
And with the five Great Lords on the Space-Time Territory side plus Ye Tian's duplicated bodies, they were not inferior to Qin Yu's side in terms of numbers.
As long as Ye Tian could defeat Qin Yu, they would have a say.
In short, serving Qin Yu was impossible.
As Legendary Realm Lords, Binghan Lord and the others did not want to serve anyone else.
-
Blood Bone Territory.
Binghan Lord's clone descended here, and Ye Tian sensed it immediately.
"Binghan Lord, you look a bit flustered. Has something happened?" Ye Tian asked.
Binghan Lord hurriedly said, "Something big has happened. A group of Legendary Lords has come from the Boundless Sea, including the Dark Mist Lord. We suspect the Dark Mist Lord found the Boundless Sea. We searched for countless years and couldn't find it, but the Dark Mist Lord actually did. Now, these Legendary Lords from the Boundless Sea were likely brought by the Dark Mist Lord. The leading Legendary Lord is named Qin Yu, with the title True Yu Lord. His strength is likely very great; we are no match for him."
"Stall for some time; I'll be there immediately!"
Ye Tian said.
This matter was related to him; he couldn't just ignore it.
"I'm afraid I'll have to unleash my true strength this time!"
Ye Tian thought to himself.

Chapter 1701: A Battle Comparable to a Perfected Stage Legendary Lord!

Chapter 1701: A Battle Comparable to a Perfected Stage Legendary Lord!

Lord Alliance Headquarters.
Qin Yu was getting impatient. He gave a final ultimatum: "I will give you one last chance. Are you willing to submit to me? If you do not answer now, then you shall never answer again!"
After speaking, Qin Yu's aura erupted completely.
Boom!!!
The entire Space-Time Territory and the Lord Alliance Headquarters were nearly frozen under a terrifying power. Those in the Eternal Stage had no ability to move at all, as if everything had been imprisoned—even space-time itself was locked down.
This was the strength of a near-Perfected Stage Legendary Lord, far surpassing ordinary Initial Stage Lords and even further beyond ordinary Legendary Stage experts.
"This... such a terrifying aura. Can the Endless Lord defeat such a being?"
Bing Han Lord began to have doubts, her heart starting to waver.
Not only was she doubting, but even the other Legendary Lords were beginning to falter. After all, they did not want to perish!
Right at this moment, Ye Tian finally arrived on the scene.
If he hadn't arrived, and if these five Legendary Lords had all defected to Qin Yu, he would have been left to fight a lone battle.
"Young Master Qin Yu, this person is the Endless Lord, Ye Tian!"
Seeing Ye Tian appear, Dark Mist Lord spoke immediately.
Boom!!!!!
Qin Yu struck Dark Mist Lord with a palm, directly causing Dark Mist Lord's body to crack. Countless particles suffered annihilation, and he was instantly heavily injured.
This was his true body, not an avatar; he had nearly been killed in a single blow.
At this moment, Dark Mist Lord was furious inside, but on the surface, he displayed a look of complete innocence.
"Young Master Qin Yu, what did I do wrong?" Dark Mist Lord asked.
"Hmph!" Qin Yu snorted coldly and said, "Dark Mist Lord, you dare to toy with this young master? You previously said the Endless Lord was merely an Immortal Stage Lord, but is he an Immortal Stage Lord now? He is clearly a Legendary Stage Lord, and he hasn't just entered the Legendary Stage—he has reached the Initial Stage, and specifically the seventh step of the Initial Stage. He is the highest-cultivated Legendary Lord in this Space-Time Territory. This young master hates being deceived above all else. If it weren't for the fact that you had some merit in bringing me here, you would be dead right now!"
"What? A Seventh-Step Initial Stage Legendary Lord?"
Dark Mist Lord was dumbfounded.
He observed Ye Tian carefully. Ye Tian really was a Legendary Lord, and he had even stepped into the Initial Stage that Dark Mist Lord dreamed of. Furthermore, he far surpassed ordinary Initial Stage experts. As for exactly which step of the Initial Stage he had reached, Dark Mist Lord's own realm was too low to see through it.
But Qin Yu had no reason to lie to him. If Qin Yu said Ye Tian had reached the Seventh-Step Initial Stage, then he must have reached that realm.
For a moment, he didn't know how to explain.
After all, not much time had passed since his battle with Ye Tian. No matter how good Ye Tian's talent was, in a place like the Space-Time Territory, being lucky enough to break through to become a Legendary Lord would already be quite impressive. How could he have suddenly leaped to the seventh step of the Initial Stage?
This was not normal!
If he were in Qin Yu's position, he wouldn't believe it either.
"Young Master Qin Yu, I really did not deceive you!" Dark Mist Lord said anxiously.
Qin Yu simply waved his hand, signaling Dark Mist Lord to shut up.
He no longer cared what the truth of the matter was.
He only wanted to handle the matter of Ye Tian now; everything else could wait until later.
"You are quite good. To be able to cultivate to the Seventh-Step Initial Stage in a place like the Source Sea... are you willing to become my guard?" Qin Yu invited.
As for whether this invitation was sincere, only he knew.
But even if it were a sincere invitation, Ye Tian could not possibly agree.
Thus, he refused directly: "Zhen Yu Lord, I do not have the habit of being a guard for others. This is the Source Sea Space-Time Territory, and outsiders are not particularly welcome. If Zhen Yu Lord has no other business, please leave."
Whoosh!
A frigid aura erupted from Qin Yu's body, turning into an endless killing intent that pierced through infinite space-time and rushed toward Ye Tian.
"You dare speak to me like that? You seek death!!!!"
Qin Yu attacked, and from the very first move, he had no intention of holding back.
He directly erupted with all his power, performing one of his top-tier Legendary Eternal Techniques—Endless Fire Prison!
Buzz buzz buzz!!!!!
Seemingly infinite fire prisons stacked continuously. In reality, this involved space, forming a cycle. Without sufficient power, one could not break the Endless Fire Prison and would be trapped inside, burned to death by the fire prison's flame power.
"What a terrifying attack!!!"
One by one, the Legendary Lords retreated, not daring to touch Qin Yu's attack. The five Legendary Lords of the Space-Time Territory also dodged away.
Right then, a power of extreme strength erupted from Ye Tian's body.
Rip! With a tearing sound!!!!
The Endless Fire Prison was actually shattered directly by Ye Tian. Those terrifying flames were unable to harm Ye Tian at all.
Ye Tian walked out, bathed in the dissipating flames of the Endless Fire Prison. With a shake of his body, those flames suffered complete annihilation.
"These flames of yours belong to a certain Eternal Dao of fire, but unfortunately, their power is still a bit lacking," Ye Tian said with a smile.
Boom!!!!
The two collided and began to fight. After only a few exchanges, Qin Yu was sent flying back.
Abruptly.
A Will Slaying Void Sword, composed entirely of Eternal Original Force, pierced through. No matter how Qin Yu tried to block, his body was still pierced by the sword, and he was instantly significantly injured.
"A Legendary-grade Eternal Technique!!!!! Impossible! You are merely an Initial Stage Lord, how could you create a Legendary-grade Eternal Technique? Even many Domain Stage Legendary Lords aren't necessarily able to create a Legendary-grade Eternal Technique!!!"
Qin Yu roared.
At this moment, his mindset truly collapsed.
He had thought this would be a great opportunity, but instead, he had encountered a Legendary Lord like Ye Tian—a Legendary Lord who knew a Legendary-grade Eternal Technique. Even in the Boundless Sea, such a person would be a legendary peerless monstrous talent, far beyond what he could compare to.
"No, I haven't lost yet. I still have an Eternal Supreme Treasure!!!!"
Qin Yu thought.
Immediately, he activated his Eternal Supreme Treasure—the Fire Domain Sword!
This was the Fire Domain Sword, which could greatly amplify his combat power. In the Boundless Sea, the Fire Domain Sword was an Eternal Supreme Treasure that held a respectable rank, not belonging to the lowest tier.
Once Qin Yu held the Fire Domain Sword, his combat power was already comparable to a true Perfected Stage Legendary Lord. Meanwhile, the strength Ye Tian had just displayed was also only comparable to a Perfected Stage Legendary Lord.
"Kill!"
Qin Yu fought with all his might, refusing to accept defeat.
He also seemed to have forgotten that Ye Tian possessed several avatars, but in reality, Ye Tian only needed one replicated body to defeat Qin Yu.
Seeing Qin Yu use an Eternal Supreme Treasure, Ye Tian no longer hid his strength and activated his Hunyuan Command.

Chapter 1702: Easy Crushing! Dark Mist Lord's Memories!

Chapter 1702: Easy Crushing! Dark Mist Lord's Memories!

Buzz!!!
With the Hunyuan Token's blessing on his body, Ye Tian created his own Will Rule Domain. Every legendary-level Eternal Technique could exert terrifying effects.
At this moment, Ye Tian was comparable to a weaker Domain Realm Legendary Lord; his strength was far greater than Qin Yu's.
Boom!!!!
Qin Yu's physical body cracked under a single Eternal Extreme Dao Punch from Ye Tian. Meanwhile, Qin Yu's attacks landed on Ye Tian's Will Wall Light and were all intercepted. Only a small portion of power penetrated the Will Wall Light, but it was neutralized by the Void True Body.
Ultimately, none of Qin Yu's attacks could cause any damage to Ye Tian.
Conversely, every one of Ye Tian's strikes was enough to heavily injure Qin Yu. Thus, the outcome of the battle was already decided.
"Hurry up and attack together!"
Qin Yu grew anxious and immediately ordered.
Swish, swish, swish!!!
The group of Legendary Realm Lords under Qin Yu's command no longer remained silent and attacked one after another to help Qin Yu. The Dark Mist Lord also gritted his teeth and went up to help.
Things had already developed to this point; he could no longer reconcile with Ye Tian. He feared that even the other Legendary Realm Lords would not be polite to him.
Instead of that, it was better to choose to deal with Ye Tian directly. If they could truly turn the situation around, there might still be a slim chance of survival.
With so many Legendary Realm Lords, although their individual strength wasn't great, they would be a huge help if they coordinated with Qin Yu.
But at the moment they were about to act, Ye Tian's copy bodies struck. The other Legendary Realm Lords of the Spacetime Territory did not stand idly by either, choosing to step forward to block these Legendary Realm Lords from the Boundless Sea.
The Dark Mist Lord was also targeted by one of Ye Tian's copy bodies. Although this copy body did not have an Eternal Treasure, its combat power was comparable to a Perfected Realm Legendary Lord. The Dark Mist Lord was merely an ordinary Legendary Lord; how could he be Ye Tian's match?
In the past, the Dark Mist Lord might have had the qualifications to fight Ye Tian for a bit, but now he had no chance at all.
"Quick, come help me!"
The Dark Mist Lord panicked, pleading with the other Legendary Realm Lords to help him resist Ye Tian's copy body. But everyone else had their own opponents; who would help him?
Swish!
The Dark Mist Lord used Dark Mist Shadow Body, transforming into multiple shadow bodies.
At that moment, Ye Tian directly unleashed a legendary-level Eternal Technique—Billion-Tier Void!
Buzz!
Countless voids compressed into a single layer, instantly causing the Dark Mist Lord's shadow bodies to collapse. Just as the Dark Mist Lord was about to perish, Ye Tian stopped and merely sealed him.
For now, the Dark Mist Lord still had value, so he could not be killed.
Next.
Ye Tian's several copy bodies attacked, blasting and killing the Legendary Realm Lords one by one. In a short while, only Qin Yu remained; all his subordinates had been killed.
"Endless Lord, this is just my avatar. How about you let me go?"
Qin Yu conceded.
"No," Ye Tian refused.
"Endless Lord, I am a member of the Qin Family from the Boundless Sea. Do you really want to become my enemy completely?" Qin Yu roared in fury.
"An Eternal Treasure is worth becoming your enemy!"
Ye Tian said with a smile.
Qin Yu could not refute. The value of an Eternal Treasure was indeed high. Had he not thought the Source Sea was too weak and that he wouldn't perish, he wouldn't have let this avatar bring the Eternal Treasure, the Fire Domain Sword.
The value of an Eternal Treasure was enough to make two Legendary Realm Lords turn against each other. For an Eternal Treasure, Ye Tian would indeed kill him.
If it were him, he would definitely do the same.
As for threats? Heh, if threats were useful, there wouldn't be so much killing in the Boundless Sea or anywhere else.
Swish, swish, swish!!!!
Ye Tian's several copy bodies joined forces to attack Qin Yu, completely stripping him of his last hope of escape.
Soon, Qin Yu was on the brink of death. At this time, Ye Tian did not choose to kill him but chose to seal him instead.
This was to seize the Eternal Treasure, the Fire Domain Sword, within his body.
If he killed Qin Yu, the Fire Domain Sword would form a spacetime barrier and exist in an unreachable spacetime. At that point, Ye Tian would need to comprehend the Eternal Dao within the Fire Domain Sword and cultivate it to the Entry stage before he could touch the sword.
But if he forcibly stripped the Fire Domain Sword while Qin Yu was still alive and then forcibly refined it, the sword would be unable to escape into spacetime. Then, even after killing Qin Yu, he could still reach the Fire Domain Sword. This was the true method to take the Fire Domain Sword.
Previously, Ye Tian hadn't thought of this method, and since that place was a prison, there were many inconveniences.
But now, Ye Tian didn't need to worry about that.
Swish!
Ye Tian's copy body took the sealed Qin Yu and Dark Mist Lord and left, heading toward the Blood Bone Territory.
As for the corpses of the other Legendary Realm Lords, Ye Tian gave one to each of the five Legendary Realm Lords. The treasures on them were also left to the five Legendary Lords. This had been agreed upon beforehand; otherwise, the five Legendary Lords would not have acted so decisively.
The entire net worth of a Legendary Realm Lord from the Boundless Sea—the five Legendary Lords were very curious and tempted by how many treasures it contained. There might even be treasures or inheritances that could help them break through.
Immediately, the five Legendary Lords went back one by one to check their gains. As for the consequences and impact of this matter, they could discuss it slowly in the future; there was no rush for now.
-
One of Ye Tian's copy bodies handled Qin Yu's matter, while another handled the Dark Mist Lord's matter.
He wanted to obtain some information from the Dark Mist Lord, such as information about the Boundless Sea, how to get there, and so on.
Getting the Dark Mist Lord to speak voluntarily was almost impossible.
The Dark Mist Lord likely guessed his own end, so he wouldn't tell the truth. Even if he did speak, it would likely be a deceptive trap.
Therefore, to obtain real information, he could only forcibly dismantle the Dark Mist Lord's will to obtain his memories.
If they were at the same tier, it would be impossible. But Ye Tian was much stronger than the Dark Mist Lord, so there was a certain hope of obtaining his memories.
To ensure success, Ye Tian first copied the Dark Mist Lord's body and used this copy body for experiments. After a long period of experimentation, Ye Tian had enough confidence to seize the Dark Mist Lord's memories, and only then did he begin.
Buzz!!!
Ye Tian's extremely powerful will power penetrated the Dark Mist Lord's will. Because Ye Tian was so familiar with the Dark Mist Lord's will, he easily completed the memory seizure, though it still caused the Dark Mist Lord's will to collapse.
But since the memories were already in hand, Ye Tian didn't care.
Immediately, he obliterated the Dark Mist Lord.

Chapter 1703: Preparing to Build the Spacetime Ladder!

Chapter 1703: Preparing to Build the Spacetime Ladder!

Ye Tian browsed the Dark Mist Lord's memories, focusing only on the ones he wanted, and soon learned the location of the Boundless Sea.
In reality, the Boundless Sea was not very far from the Source Sea, but reaching it required passing through two dangerous places.
The Purple Polar Light Domain and the Darkness Barrier.
The Purple Polar Light Domain was a special zone in the void region, completely covered by a purple light. It was a forbidden zone that even void beasts dared not enter. Without the strength of a Legendary Realm Lord, entering would result in being assimilated by the purple polar power and becoming part of the domain. It was said that the Purple Polar Light Domain expanded every Eternal Year, and the energy required for this expansion came from external organisms.
Furthermore, while Legendary Realm Lords could enter without dying, they would still be suppressed. Their speed would become extremely slow within the Purple Polar Light Domain, and once inside, they would lose all sense of direction, not knowing how long they would need to fly to cross it.
Facing the unknown, several Legendary Realm Lords from the Spacetime Territory had tried to cross the Purple Polar Light Domain, but they eventually gave up due to a lack of persistence or failing to find the right direction. After all, there were no opportunities within the Purple Polar Light Domain, so it wasn't worth their exploration.
If one crossed the Purple Polar Light Domain and found the right direction, they would enter another void region. After flying further, they would reach the Darkness Barrier—an endless barrier formed entirely of darkness power. Without sufficient strength, one simply could not break the Darkness Barrier to continue forward.
Basically, a Legendary Realm Lord had the strength to break the Darkness Barrier and enter the next region.
Passing through these two places led to the void region where the Boundless Sea was located. From there, flying to the Boundless Sea was very easy.
However, the six Legendary Lords of the Source Sea had never completely flown across the Purple Polar Light Domain because they didn't know what lay beyond; otherwise, they would have tried at all costs to fly through the Purple Polar Light Domain.
Now that Ye Tian knew this secret, finding the Boundless Sea was naturally very easy.
"Back then, the Dark Mist Lord likely staked everything on a desperate gamble to escape this region. He charged into the Purple Polar Light Domain and accidentally crossed it, then passed through the Darkness Barrier to find the Boundless Sea!" Ye Tian murmured.
Additionally.
He discovered from the Dark Mist Lord's memories that the lord wasn't captured immediately upon entering the Boundless Sea. He had lived there for a period before being accidentally captured by Qin Yu. The Dark Mist Lord also had some understanding of the Boundless Sea.
For example, the general situation of the Boundless Sea and the strength of the Qin Family.
The Qin Family was a top-tier power in the Boundless Sea, possessing one Half-step Legend Realm Lord, three Transcendence Realm Legendary Lords, six Domain Realm Legendary Lords, and over a dozen Perfected Realm Legendary Lords. As for Initial Realm Legendary Lords, the Qin Family had even more.
Qin Yu was highly valued in the Qin Family, which was why he was bestowed an Eternal Supreme Treasure.
An Eternal Supreme Treasure was not only incredibly precious to Qin Yu but also very important to the Qin Family.
It could be said that the Qin Family wouldn't let this go; they would inevitably come to reclaim the Eternal Supreme Treasure.
When that time came, it wouldn't be Qin Yu arriving, but the Qin Family's Domain Realm Legendary Lords, or perhaps even a Transcendence Realm Legendary Lord.
No matter how strong Ye Tian was, he couldn't contend with the experts of the Qin Family.
Of course, Ye Tian had several choices.
First, leave the Source Sea; then neither the Qin Family nor Qin Yu could find him.
Second, find a backer that the Qin Family would fear immensely, preventing them from acting against him.
At this moment, Ye Tian thought of a power—the True Void Sacred Land!
The True Void Sacred Land was a power truly at the Peak of the Boundless Sea, far beyond what the Qin Family could compare to.
Previously, Ye Tian had learned about the True Void Sacred Land from the Prisoner of Mount Mo, but that was a long time ago. Now, he found more information from the Dark Mist Lord's memories, as the Dark Mist Lord had specifically inquired about it.
The current True Void Sacred Land indeed lacked its former glory because a great war had broken out in the Boundless Sea long ago, and the True Void Sacred Land was involved. Many powers perished in that war. Although the True Void Sacred Land didn't perish, its losses were heavy, with five Legend Realm Lords falling.
Even so, the True Void Sacred Land remained the most top-tier Peak power in the Boundless Sea.
However, since that war, the True Void Sacred Land rarely recruited members, and the requirements had become much higher. Joining the True Void Sacred Land was extremely difficult.
"I previously gained many benefits from the ruins of the True Void Sacred Land, so perhaps I have a destiny with them. I could join this power. From the Dark Mist Lord's memories, the Boundless Sea is connected to multiple powerful Eternal Seas, and Legendary Realm Lords from other Eternal Seas have joined powers in the Boundless Sea. So, I am also eligible to join the True Void Sacred Land," Ye Tian thought.
Flying directly from the Source Sea to the Boundless Sea was too slow. By the time he arrived, the Qin Family's experts might have already reached the Source Sea, and it would be too late.
There was only one way.
"I must build a Spacetime Ladder!"
Ye Tian decided.
The Spacetime Ladder was a method used in the Boundless Sea to reach other Eternal Seas. It used Eternal Supreme Treasures to stack layers of spacetime and then applied the Spacetime Ladder secret technique to construct a passage to other Eternal Seas.
Since Ye Tian now knew the spacetime coordinates of the Boundless Sea's void region and was currently in the Source Sea, he could naturally calculate the Source Sea's position.
The Dark Mist Lord had accidentally stumbled into the Boundless Sea and didn't know the Source Sea's spacetime coordinates. Since this was an invention of the Boundless Sea, it could only be calculated slowly after returning. Otherwise, he could have helped Qin Yu build a Spacetime Ladder back then.
"The Dark Mist Lord and Qin Yu are truly my opportunities. Otherwise, how would I know the location of the Boundless Sea or about the Spacetime Ladder?"
The Spacetime Ladder was a common secret technique in the Boundless Sea. The only difficulty was the Eternal Supreme Treasure, which was rare. Not many Legendary Realm Lords possessed one, but Ye Tian had more than one, so he could build it.
On the other side, after Ye Tian took the Eternal Supreme Treasure, the Fire Domain Sword, from Qin Yu, he immediately killed Qin Yu and began constructing the Spacetime Ladder.
In the Boundless Sea, at the Qin Family.
Qin Yu immediately sensed that his clone had fallen and was furious.
He knew his Eternal Supreme Treasure, the Fire Domain Sword, was completely stolen by Ye Tian. He no longer planned to hide it and intended to inform the Qin Family elders. Even if he were punished, contributing the location of a strange Eternal Sea would be enough to make up for his mistake and would even be a great merit!
Thus, he went to the Qin Family's main hall to seek an audience with the Qin Family's ancestor...

Chapter 1704: The Qin Family's Mobilization, Entering the Boundless Sea!

Chapter 1704: The Qin Family's Mobilization, Entering the Boundless Sea!

The Qin family ancestor Qin Yu wanted to see was naturally the ancestor of his own lineage, a Transcendence Stage Legendary Lord. In the Boundless Sea, Legendary Stage Lords were too mysterious, and Half-step Legendary Stage Lords were all in seclusion attempting to break through to the Legendary Stage and were few in number. In reality, Transcendence Stage Legendary Lords were the overlords on the surface of the Boundless Sea, sufficient to deter all quarters.
Qin Yu's ancestor was named Qin Wuyuan, and he was not considered weak even among Transcendence Stage Legendary Lords, possessing a certain level of fame within the Boundless Sea.
"Descendant Qin Yu requests an audience with the Ancestor!"
Qin Yu shouted while standing outside the great hall.
"Come in!"
Qin Wuyuan spoke.
Whoosh!
The hall doors opened, and Qin Yu walked inside.
Soon, he met Qin Wuyuan.
Clad in a black robe, Qin Wuyuan sat upon a throne, quietly scrutinizing Qin Yu as he asked, "Qin Yu, have you come to see me because you've caused trouble?"
Qin Yu immediately said, "Ancestor, I have lost the Fire Domain Sword!"
Boom!!!
The aura of the Transcendence Stage suppressed him, making Qin Yu's entire body tremble.
Between the Initial Stage and the Transcendence Stage lay the Perfected Stage and the Domain Stage; the difference in strength between the two was simply too vast.
Consequently, Qin Yu could not resist his ancestor's aura at all, and of course, he did not dare to resist.
"The Fire Domain Sword is an Eternal Treasure of our Qin family. Although our Qin family is very ancient, we only have fewer than twenty Eternal Treasures. You were only at the Initial Stage yet were able to obtain an Eternal Treasure because the Qin family valued you. As a result, you actually lost an Eternal Treasure. Do you know how great a loss this is to the Qin family???"
Qin Wuyuan was incomparably furious.
Had Qin Yu not been a genius of the Qin family and someone he held high hopes for, he would have truly wanted to slap Qin Yu to death.
Qin Yu hurriedly said, "Ancestor, although I lost the Fire Domain Sword, I found an extremely weak Source Sea. This Source Sea has only a handful of Legendary Lords. The most powerful one is an Initial Stage Legendary Lord, but the opponent's strength is much greater than mine, and they possess an Eternal Treasure. They have even created a Legendary-level Eternal Technique, possessing combat power roughly equivalent to a weaker Domain Stage Legendary Lord."
"A new Source Sea? Tell me its approximate location. I will check it. If it happens to be the territory of some powerful force, we won't be able to take it," Qin Wuyuan said.
"Yes, Ancestor!"
